summarization:
This smartphone UI screen appears to be part of a photo editing or review application. The main contents and functions visible in this UI screen include:

1. **Undo Button (Left Arrow)**: Located on the left side, this button likely allows the user to undo the last action or edit made to the photo.
2. **Save/Confirm Button (Checkmark)**: Positioned in the center, this button is typically used to save or confirm the current state of the photo after editing.
3. **Cancel Button (X)**: Found on the right side, this button is usually used to cancel the current action or discard changes made to the photo.

The background shows a dark image, possibly indicating that the user is in the process of editing or reviewing a photo taken in low light conditions.
